sn45.55:1.1: Suriyassa bhikkhave udayato etam pubbaṅgamaṃ etam pubbanimittaṃ yad idam aruṇuggam ||
sn45.55:1.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa uppādāya etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittaṃ yad idam yonisomanasikārasampadā || || 3.
sn45.55:1.3: Yonisomanasikārasampannassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam bhāvessati a- amaggam bahulīkarissati || ||
sn45.55:1.4: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkaroti || || 4.
sn45.55:1.5: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitam virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmim || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ||
sn45.55:1.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno ariyam atthaṅgikam maggam bhāveti a- a- bahulīkaroti || || 2.
